It is attached to a green, hairy stem that extends diagonally across the top right of the frame. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green, suggesting foliage.

The background blur is uniform but lacks the optical characteristics of a real lens bokeh, appearing more like a Gaussian smear typical of AI generation.
